adapterNotes.namespaces: @zero-admin/* module scopes, zero_admin_* PHP API and events; public npm package identities preserved
adapterNotes.integration: Existing Zero mount/login/schema/SCF/media bridge retained; native WordPress routes, dashboard registry and menu restored
adapterNotes.compatibility: Pinned WordPress package types/controls/styles; PHP 8.2 theme lookup; null editor-preview links
adapterNotes.services: No upstream telemetry transport; AI provider seam retained without hosted service; example widgets explicitly labeled
adapterNotes.privacy: Private tracker and hosted-infrastructure references in documentation redacted
adapterNotes.metadata: Original root configuration and PHP test bootstrap retained for provenance; not the active standalone runner
